briefing: Transmission received. Earth is falling apart — resources are gone, the surface is failing, and there is no time left to wait.
You are the last line of defense against extinction. A colony ship sits fueled and waiting, but it needs a proven flight path before launch.
Your first mission: reach the Moon. Everything that comes after depends on you.
The Moon landing was a success. But Earth's situation has only worsened — conventional resources can no longer sustain the colonies.
Scientists have detected rare isotopes in the gas clouds near Jupiter. Use Saturn's gravity well for a slingshot maneuver and push deeper into the system.
The planets are stable — no orbital drift. Plot your course carefully. There is no turning back.
Jupiter is behind you. The inner system is gone — Earth, the Moon, Saturn. All of it is now a memory.
This is the final leg. Navigate past Neptune using its gravity, and reach Pluto at the edge of the solar system.
Beyond Pluto there is nothing. No planet, no station, no rescue. This is humanity's last step — make it count.
